name: M8.Cutoff.limit_bounds
statement: ∀ N : ℕ, M8.Cutoff.limit N ≤ N-1 ∧ M8.Cutoff.limit N ≤ Nat.log 2 (N+1) ∧ (0 < N → M8.Cutoff.limit N < N)
guidance: Unfold limit; min_le_left/right, Nat.sub_lt for positive N. Includes N=1 cutoff0 and total N=0 definition, no higher-span assumption. Return tactic lines only; no leading by.
